summary: 숲이나 나무가 있는 정원에 사는 흔한 겨울철새로, 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 무리 지어 다니며 여러 낙엽활엽수의 씨앗을 따 먹으며 겨울을 나고, 번식기에는 곤충을 먹는다. 번식지에서는 알을 3~6개 낳는다. 세계적으로는 유라시아 대륙에 분포한다.

art.subject: Hawfinch (Coccothraustes coccothraustes), adult male in winter, as seen in Korean woodland from November to March: crown and cheeks warm tawny-orange brown; black lores and a narrow black line around the bill base joining a small black bib on the chin; broad grey collar across the nape and neck sides; mantle and back dark chestnut-brown; wings glossy blue-black with a broad whitish-buff patch on the greater coverts; underparts pinkish-brown, paler on the belly, undertail coverts white; short tail chestnut-brown in the centre with a broad white tip. Massive conical bill, pale bluish-white in winter; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a deciduous branch, cracking a seed
art.scene: Korean winter woodland of bare broadleaf trees; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view perched: massive pale bluish-white conical bill, tawny-orange head, black lores and chin bib, grey nape collar, pinkish-brown body, blue-black wings with a pale covert patch, short tail with a white tip
adult, head detail in spring: the same massive bill now metallic steel-blue, black lores and a black line around the bill base, thick neck with grey nape
adult in flight, seen from above: blue-black wings with a broad white band across the primaries, pale covert panel, chestnut back, short tail with a broad white tip
art.build: Large, heavy-set finch, about 18cm, bigger and much stouter than a sparrow; huge head, thick neck and short tail give a top-heavy, bull-necked shape. Bill massive, deep-based and conical with a straight culmen, nearly as long as the head. Legs short, pinkish-brown. Flight fast and bounding, showing a broad white band across the primaries, a pale panel on the wing coverts and a broad white tail tip. Feeds in trees and on the ground under them, cracking hard seeds.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow bill or a black head; those belong to Japanese Grosbeak (Eophona personata) and Chinese Grosbeak (Eophona migratoria).
Do not give it a long tail or a slim finch shape; the tail is short and the head huge.
Do not paint the bill small or dark in the winter bird; it is huge and pale.
Do not paint the whole tail black; it is chestnut in the centre with a broad white tip.
